itens.titulo: Dólar cai com eleições em foco e fica abaixo de R$ 5; moeda recua mais de 4% na semana
itens.descricao: Dólar cai com eleições em foco e fica abaixo de R$ 5; moeda recua mais de 4% na semana Money Times
itens.texto:
Dólar cai com eleições em foco e fica abaixo de R$ 5; moeda recua mais de 4% na semana
O dólar à vista encerrou a semana, a primeira após o primeiro turno das eleições, em queda ante o real, com os investidores otimistas com uma eventual alternância de poder.
Nesta sexta-feira (9), o dólar encerrou R$ 4,9851 no mercado à vista, com queda de 0,78%.
O movimento local destoou do desempenho do dólar global. Por volta de 17h (horário de Brasília), o DXY, indicador que compara a moeda a uma cesta de seis divisas globais, como euro e libra, operava com alta de 0,11%, aos 102.250 pontos.
Na semana, o dólar acumulou queda de 4,44% ante o real.
Receba gratuitamente as newsletters do Money Times
O que movimentou o dólar hoje?
Os investidores locais continuaram a precificar uma eventual mudança de governo com novas pesquisas eleitorais apontando para uma vitória de Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) no segundo turno das eleições.
“O movimento de baixa do câmbio foi impulsionado por motivos estritamente domésticos: o forte apetite ao risco dos investidores, embalado pela primeira rodada de pesquisas do segundo turno que mostra Flávio à frente de Lula”, afirma Emerson Junior, head de câmbio e contas internacionais da Convexa Investimentos.
Ontem (8), no início da noite, Flávio apareceu na liderança, com 49%, contra 45% do presidente Lula, na primeira pesquisa do Instituto Datafolha para o segundo turno das eleições presidenciais. O cenário é de empate técnico no limite da margem de erro de 2 pontos porcentuais.
Já a AtlasIntel/Bloomberg, divulgada nesta manhã, também mostrou o senador na liderança, com 51,1%, contra 45,7% de Lula.
Considerado mais favorável ao mercado, o filho do ex-presidente também é o favorito do mercado para vencer a disputa pela Presidência no segundo turno, em 25 de outubro.

itens.titulo: Alibaba's Earnings Turn May Be Underpriced
itens.descricao: Alibaba's Earnings Turn May Be Underpriced Yahoo Finance
trechos: Alibaba (BABA, Financials), the Chinese e-commerce and cloud giant, jumped 4.5% Friday after Bank of America said investors were still underestimating an upcoming profit increase.
GuruFocus has detected 3 Warning Sign with BABA.
The bank raised its price objective on the stock to $178 from $175 and maintained its Buy rating.
That objective implies an upside of approximately 68% from Thursday's close of $105.70.
Bank of America forecasts cloud revenue to climb 52% in the September quarter, compared with 45% earlier.
Cloud margins are forecast to rise to 12.9% from 11.6%.
While losses from Alibaba's AI laboratories and apps may shrink to 11 billion yuan from 14 billion yuan, this could affect the earnings equation.
The bank anticipates the cloud gains to offset AI losses by the December quarter and foresees the combined companies becoming breakeven in the second half of fiscal 2027.

itens.titulo: Bitcoin Rebounds After Rough Week, But Traders Are Pricing In More Downside
itens.descricao: Bitcoin Rebounds After Rough Week, But Traders Are Pricing In More Downside Yahoo Finance
trechos: The crypto markets are breathing today, with the total capitalization up 2.1% to $2.89 trillion on Friday.
The bounce recovers only part of the damage, since the market stood above $3 trillion a week ago, when Bitcoin was pressing against its yearly high.
The Fear & Greed Index dropped to 56, a neutral reading, down from the 71 that put sentiment firmly in "greed" territory on October 2.
Bitcoin ETFs alone shed $484.9 million on Wednesday, their worst day since June 25, and a further $244 million on Thursday, according to Decrypt's ETF tracker.
Bitcoin trades around $82,837 on Friday, up 1.38% on the day, after dipping to $80,427 on Thursday, its lowest level since early September.
The daily candle opened at $81,711 and has ranged between $81,553 and $83,443.
On the four-hour chart, price still trades below the 50-period exponential moving average, so the short-term trend has not turned.

Myriad, a prediction market owned by Decrypt's parent company Dastan, gives a 67% chance that Bitcoin trades at or below $80,000 at some point in October, with 40% odds for $77,500 and 24% for $75,000.

itens.titulo: Coca-Cola Seeks to Unwind $5 Billion Costa Coffee Acquisition
itens.descricao: Coca-Cola Seeks to Unwind $5 Billion Costa Coffee Acquisition Yahoo Finance
trechos: Key Stats for Coca-Cola Stock - Price change for Coca-Cola stock in last 6 months: 12% - $KO Stock Price as of Oct.
8: $88 - 52-Week High: $92 - $KO Stock Price Target: $94 What Happened?
Coca-Cola (KO:NYSE) is looking to unwind its $5 billion purchase of British coffeehouse Costa Coffee, Semafor reported on Thursday.
The company bought Costa in 2018 for $5.1 billion.
On the Q2 call, Coca-Cola reported 6% organic revenue growth.
Over two years, volume growth was 2%.
Comparable gross margin rose about 120 basis points.
Comparable operating margin rose about 90 basis points.
